evidence: A9c DERIVED RESISTANCE/TEMPERATURE CEILING FROM COMMITTED MODEL OUTPUTS AND NIST COPPER DATUM

external_datum.name: IEC standard-copper resistance temperature coefficient at 20 C as reproduced by NIST Copper Wire Tables
external_datum.source_boundary: The coefficient describes standard/good annealed copper. It does not establish this winding's manufactured resistance, joints, insulation build or pre-shot temperature.

limits: The temperature conversion assumes the model's 1.00 resistance state is the finished winding at 20 C.
Manufacturing tolerance, terminations, cable resistance and semiconductor loss can consume the derived margin before copper temperature does.
The NIST copper coefficient does not establish a manufactured winding state or hardware qualification.
